'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[2025 Gaza City offensive]]
****At least 61 [[Palestinians]] are killed in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] attacks across the [[Gaza Strip]] and [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/10/1/live-a-least-61-killed-as-global-sumud-flotilla-nears-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***The [[Ministry of Energy (Ukraine)|Ukrainian energy ministry]] declares an "emergency situation" at the [[Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant]] as the [[Chernobyl New Safe Confinement|New Safe Confinement]] structure meant to prevent radioactive material from spreading into the environment experiences a three-hour [[power outage]] due to a [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] on an energy facility in nearby [[Slavutych]], [[Kyiv Oblast]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/chornobyl-nuclear-plant-loses-power-after-russian-attack-on-nearby-town-energy-ministry-says/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]
**[[Volodymyr Leontiev]], the former Russia-installed mayor of [[Nova Kakhovka]], is killed in a Ukrainian drone strike. [https://kyivindependent.com/drone-attacks-collaborator-in-russian-occupied-nova-kakhovka-in-kherson-oblast-kremlin-proxy-claims (''The Kyiv Independent'')] [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2025/10/01/russian-installed-official-killed-in-occupied-ukraine-a90685 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Siege of El Fasher]]
***As [[El Fasher]]'s humanitarian crisis continues to drastically deteriorate, the [[Rapid Support Forces]] reportedly makes further gains against besieged garrison units mainly composed of [[Darfur Joint Protection Force|former Darfuri rebels]] and their [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] allies. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgnz76vr6lo (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Embargo of Russian oil during the Russo-Ukrainian War]], [[Serbia–United States relations]]
**The [[U.S. Department of the Treasury]] postpones [[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War|sanctions]] on [[Serbia]]n oil company [[Naftna Industrija Srbije]], of which Russian state-owned companies [[Gazprom]] and [[Gazprom Neft]] hold a majority of shares, until October 8, 2025. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/serbias-nis-granted-us-sanctions-waiver-until-october-8-2025-10-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Cebu earthquake]]
**[[Cebu]] [[Governor of Cebu|governor]] [[Pam Baricuatro]] declares a [[State of calamity (Philippines)|state of calamity]] and suspends classes throughout the province due to the {{M|w|6.9}} earthquake yesterday. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/c4gq591q939t (BBC News)]
**The [[National Grid Corporation of the Philippines]] reports that power has been restored shortly after midnight in five islands in the central [[Philippines]], including Cebu. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/3113836/at-least-69-killed-by-central-philippines-quake-many-missing (AFP via ''Bangkok Post'')]
*[[Arerti Maryam Church collapse]]
**At least 36 people are killed and over 200 others are injured when an under construction church collapses in Areti, [[Amhara Region]], [[Ethiopia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ethiopia-collapsed-church-588da32d2f8244b82209d8660b565b53 (AP)] [https://www.trtworld.com/article/a9606de8e561 (TRT World)]
*The death toll from the collapse of a ''[[pesantren]]'' in [[Sidoarjo Regency|Sidoarjo]], [[East Java]], [[Indonesia]], rises to six as rescue workers continue their search. Dozens of students remain missing and approximately 100 others were injured in the collapse. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-islamic-school-collapse-java-16259f65a7ff76165dc67020c7d619ee (AP)]
*Two workers are killed, several are injured and others are reported missing when the ceiling of an under-renovation [[seraglio|serail]] in [[Damascus]], [[Syria]], collapses. [https://apnews.com/article/damascus-syria-ceiling-collapse-marjeh-serail-workers-fab07a5cf003ab824615ee96279eea6f (AP)]
*A flight attendant is injured when two [[CRJ-900]] aircraft, one operated by [[Delta Air Lines]] and one by [[Endeavor Air]], collide on a runway at [[LaGuardia Airport]] in [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/us-two-planes-collide-at-new-yorks-laguardia-airport/a-74211187 (DW)] [https://www.cnn.com/2025/10/02/us/lga-regional-jets-collide (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Moroccan Gen Z protests]]
**At least three people are killed in [[Lqliâa]], [[Souss-Massa]], [[Morocco]], as [[Royal Moroccan Gendarmerie|security forces]] open fire during nationwide protests over alleged [[Corruption in Morocco|corruption]] and public spending priorities. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/2/death-toll-rises-to-3-in-morocco-with-more-protests-expected (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Islamic terrorism in Europe]]
**Three men are arrested in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]], for targeting [[Jewish]] institutions and preparing a [[Terrorism in Germany|terrorist attack]] on behalf of [[Hamas]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/germany-arrests-suspected-hamas-members-believed-be-targeting-jewish-2025-10-01/ (Reuters)]
*The annual [[Oktoberfest]] is temporarily shut down in [[Munich]], [[Germany]], until 17:30 [[Central European Standard Time|local time]] due to an explosion at a house earlier in the morning which killed two people, including the perpetrator. The [[Polizeipräsidium München|police]] ultimately finds no link between the Oktoberfest and the explosion, which was related to a domestic dispute. [https://www.dw.com/en/munich-police-deployed-after-explosion-investigation-underway/a-74194643 (DW)] [https://apnews.com/article/germany-oktoberfest-closed-explosion-905642601406720cfe3abbfc5bf2af97 (AP)]
*The [[Government of Italy|Italian]] [[Carabinieri Art Squad]] seizes 21 paintings by [[Salvador Dalí]] suspected of being [[art forgery|forged pieces]] at an exhibition at the [[Palazzo Tarasconi, Parma|Palazzo Tarasconi]] in [[Parma]]. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-dali-art-forgeries-69f09f67074189451d8485556be6b468 (AP)] [https://www.independent.ie/world-news/europe/italian-police-raid-salvador-dali-exhibition-say-works-on-display-were-fake/a2118097974.html (''The Irish Independent'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Malagasy protests]]
**Protests in [[Madagascar]] continue and spread across the country, demanding the [[resignation]] of [[President of Madagascar|President]] [[Andry Rajoelina]]. Opposition leader [[Rivo Rakotovao]] says that his party will not join any new government under Rajoelina, asking him to step down. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/madagascar-protesters-demand-presidents-resignation-fifth-day-rallies-2025-10-01/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 United States federal government shutdown]]
**A [[Federal government of the United States|federal government]] [[Government shutdowns in the United States|shutdown]] occurs in the [[United States]] after a funding bill fails to be passed, the first government shutdown since [[2018–2019 United States federal government shutdown|January 2019]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/us-government-headed-to-a-shutdown-after-last-ditch-vote-fails-in-senate// (CTV News)]
*The 2025 [[Right Livelihood Award]] is awarded to a student organization in the [[Pacific Islands]] fighting [[climate change]], activist organization [[Justice for Myanmar]], [[Taiwan]]ese activist [[Audrey Tang]], and the [[Sudan]]ese [[Emergency Response Rooms]] for their work in combating injustice in their respective regions. [https://apnews.com/article/sweden-right-livelihood-award-sudan-myanmar-taiwan-2b5582af8cf6832a3801166a241b3c07 (AP)]
*Thousands of people march in [[Athens]] as part of a [[general strike]] across [[Greece]] to protest against proposed changes in [[labor law]]s that could change the [[8-hour work day]] to 13 hours, or a 48-hour [[workweek and weekend|workweek]]. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-strike-labor-f28353c37af65a9e0667f995c40ad061 (AP)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/oct/01/general-strike-against-13-hour-day-brings-greece-to-a-halt (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Matteo Rossi (politician)|Matteo Rossi]] and [[Lorenzo Bugli]] are sworn in as the new [[captains regent]] of [[San Marino]], succeeding [[Denise Bronzetti]] and [[Italo Righi]]. [https://sanmarinortv.sm/news/politica-c2/matteo-rossi-e-lorenzo-bugli-sono-i-nuovi-capitani-reggenti-a281046 (''San Marino RTV'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*A research team at the [[Free University of Berlin]] announce the detection of new [[Organic compound|organic substances]] within water vapour plumes erupting from the surface of [[Enceladus]] by [[Cassini–Huygens|''Cassini'']]{{'}}s [[Cosmic Dust Analyzer]], a potential [[biosignature]] of [[extraterrestrial life]] under the [[Saturnian moon]]'s [[icy moon|icy surface]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2025/oct/01/prospect-life-saturn-moons-rises-discovery-organic-substances (''The Guardian'')] [https://doi.org/10.1038/s41550-025-02655-y (''Nature Astronomy'')]
